name: agentic-game-factory-studio
description: Trailer, greeting video and workshop picture tools for the Agentic Game Factory.

scripts.preinstall: node -e "if (!/^bun\//.test(process.env.npm_config_user_agent ?? 'bun/')) throw new Error('This kit installs with bun: run bun install')"
scripts.trailer: bun run assets && HYPERFRAMES_NO_TELEMETRY=1 DO_NOT_TRACK=1 hyperframes render trailer --experimental-fast-capture=false --strict-variables --output renders/trailer.raw.mp4 && bun scripts/master.mjs renders/trailer.raw.mp4 renders/trailer.mp4 && rm renders/trailer.raw.mp4 && ffmpeg -v error -y -sseof -0.1 -i renders/trailer.mp4 -frames:v 1 -update 1 renders/trailer.png
scripts.check: bun test scripts && bun run assets && bun scripts/score.mjs beispiel-gmbh && HYPERFRAMES_NO_TELEMETRY=1 DO_NOT_TRACK=1 hyperframes lint trailer && HYPERFRAMES_NO_TELEMETRY=1 DO_NOT_TRACK=1 hyperframes lint greeting
